title: [AUG-206] Reserve the pin-bar height on every full-page view so it never covers controls (UI audit T3)
why_we_need_this: UI audit AUG-203 (@docs/reviews/2026-11-ui-audit.md, findings F-07, F-09, F-36, F-40): the fixed bottom pin bar `[ Sessions  Controls ]` sits on top of page content whenever a page scrolls. At the 960×600 minimum it hides the paste-a-link label and the left half of the URL input on New Transcription, covers Cancel / Restart on the transcribing view, overlaps the bottom of the session view, and the Archive bulk bar hides list rows. A user cannot click a control that is under the bar.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] One shared layout rule reserves pin-bar height + 16 px at the bottom of `.main-content` (and every full-page view: New Transcription, Setup Guide, session / transcribing view, Archive) so the last interactive element always ends above the bar when scrolled to the end
- [ ] At 960×600: the URL input and TRANSCRIBE button, the transcribing Cancel / Restart buttons, and the last Archive row are fully visible and clickable with the bar present
- [ ] Archive sticky bulk bar docks below the list or adds matching bottom padding so no row is hidden under it
- [ ] Pin-bar column toggles (live) keep working; no change to overlay open / close behaviour
- [ ] Screenshots before / after at 960×600 for New Transcription, transcribing view and Archive attached to the card
- [ ] Renderer-only change; no platform branch touched
important_constraints:
Repro screenshots: @docs/reviews/2026-11-ui-audit/02-newtranscription-min-dark.png, @docs/reviews/2026-11-ui-audit/03-newtranscription-min-dark-scrolled.png, @docs/reviews/2026-11-ui-audit/31-transcribing-min.png. Files: client/src/App.css (`.main-content`, `.pin-toggles`, archive bulk bar), client/src/components/OverlayLayer.tsx, ArchivePage.tsx. Prefer a CSS variable for the bar height so one value drives every page. Brandbook: 0 border-radius, Necron tokens.

Order: 1/3 (UI audit AUG-203 layout follow-ups). Blocks: AUG-205 (both touch `.pin-toggles`; land this one first). Related: AUG-204.

## Implementation (2026-11-09, commit 598d3f7 on master, not pushed)
Root cause: `.main-content` already had 56 px bottom padding, but `.file-upload-host` is `flex: 1; min-height: 0`, so it shrank and New Transcription overflowed it. Padding counts only after in-flow children, not after overflow, so scrolled to the end the URL input still ended 12 px above the window bottom, under the bar.

Changes (only @client/src/App.css, renderer-only, no platform branch):
- `:root` `--pin-bar-offset` 16 px (8 px ≤ 500 px), `--pin-bar-height` 38 px, `--pin-bar-reserve` = offset + height + 16 px = 70 px.
- `.main-content { padding-bottom: var(--pin-bar-reserve) }`; `.pin-toggles { bottom: var(--pin-bar-offset) }` (AUG-205 `width: max-content` kept).
- `.file-upload-host:not(:has(.live-open)) { flex: 1 0 auto; }` — shrinks only while the live panel is open (live layout unchanged).
- `.archive-bulk` no longer sticky: docked below the list (audit recommendation), shadow removed.
- OverlayLayer / ArchivePage markup untouched; overlay open/close and pin-bar column toggles untouched.

Verification: isolated server (AUGUST_DATA_DIR in scratchpad, 10 demo sessions + 1 transcribing) + Vite, Electron window 944×561 content (= 960×600 outer), DOM check of rects vs the bar (bar y 508–545) + `elementFromPoint`:
| View (scrolled to end) | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| New Transcription URL input | y 512–549, overlaps bar, click hits bar | y 442–479, clear, clickable; TRANSCRIBE clear |
| Transcribing Cancel / Restart | clear in this fixture (y 358–393) | y 344–379, clear |
| Archive last row / bulk bar | row 351–390, bar sticky (rows scroll under it) | row 337–376, bulk bar 393–451 docked below, clear |
`npx tsc --noEmit` and `npm run build` (client) pass.

Screenshots: @docs/reviews/AUG-206/before-newtranscription-960x600.png, @docs/reviews/AUG-206/after-newtranscription-960x600.png, @docs/reviews/AUG-206/before-transcribing-960x600.png, @docs/reviews/AUG-206/after-transcribing-960x600.png, @docs/reviews/AUG-206/before-archive-960x600.png, @docs/reviews/AUG-206/after-archive-960x600.png.

Not done / notes: the live panel was not exercised in a real recording (the selector leaves `.live-open` on the old rule; the live panel is 14 px shorter because of the bigger reserve). macOS not run (shared CSS). The audit's "move Cancel/Restart above the ring on short windows" (F-09) and F-36 header collapse are not in this AC. A docked bulk bar means a long list needs a scroll to reach the actions. Context: @project-context/frontend-design/README.md.

## ✅ Итог (2026-11-09)
**Что сделано:** пин-бар `[ SESSIONS / CONTROLS ]` больше не перекрывает последний контрол на полностраничных видах; на 960×600 URL-поле и TRANSCRIBE на New Transcription, Cancel / Restart на экране транскрибации и последняя строка Archive видны и кликабельны при прокрутке до конца. Bulk-бар Archive больше не плавает поверх строк — стоит под списком. Тогглы колонок Live и открытие/закрытие оверлеев не менялись.
**Как:** одна тройка переменных `--pin-bar-offset` / `--pin-bar-height` / `--pin-bar-reserve` (70 px) задаёт и позицию бара, и `padding-bottom` у `.main-content`. Корневая причина не в величине отступа (56 px уже был), а в `.file-upload-host { min-height: 0 }`: хост сжимался, контент переливался за него, а padding скролл-контейнера считается только после in-flow детей. Теперь хост сжимается только при открытой Live-панели (`:not(:has(.live-open))`). Для bulk-бара выбран вариант «пристыковать под списком» (рекомендация аудита) вместо sticky с отступом.
**Файлы:** @client/src/App.css; скриншоты @docs/reviews/AUG-206/; контекст @project-context/frontend-design/README.md.
**PR / коммиты:** без PR, напрямую в master: 598d3f7. Не запушено.
**Грабли:** первый `capturePage()` скрытого окна Electron отдаёт кадр до прокрутки — нужен повторный снимок / `invalidate()`; без этого «before» и «after» выглядели одинаково при верных DOM-замерах. Изолированные сервер и Vite остановлены по PID.
**Хвосты:** Live-панель в реальной записи не прогонялась (стала на 14 px ниже); macOS не запускался; F-09 «Cancel/Restart над кольцом на низких окнах» и F-36 (сворачивание шапки сессии) — вне AC, остаются в аудите; длинный список Archive требует прокрутки до кнопок bulk-бара.
